snippet.title: Dark Queen of Samobor - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3106050/Dark_Queen_of_Samobor/

Join Discord: https://discord.gg/Vc8cQvHfgX

PRESS KIT: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1eoPhkMZTGTIhPiO4Kf85hCVMTbM53J1u?usp=sharing

Dark Queen of Samobor is a 2.5D narrative action-adventure inspired by Croatian and Slavic mythology. Step into the pages of a cursed fairytale as a hero knight and battle through various haunting biomes, twisted creatures, and ancient horrors to reach the Dark Queen’s castle. 

Featuring handcrafted visuals, epic boss fights, and a fully directed camera – this is a dark fairytale brought to life.

Coming 2026.

Trailer narrated by Sandra Lončarić (https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0518636/)
